about_the_game:
The Silent House is a survival, decision-driven story where every ration, every risk, and every moment of hesitation could mean the end of your family’s last hope.

It begins in chaos: 120 seconds to raid your home for supplies before the undead swarm crashes through. You escape—but survival doesn’t end with escape.

In the Silent House, walls keep the horde out, but they also trap you with hunger, fear, and impossible choices. Ration food or starve, rest or collapse, venture into the ruins or rot in safety. Survival here is never safety.

What Awaits Inside The Silent House

  • ⏱ Desperate Prologue – 120-second countdown of frantic scavenging.

  • 🧟 A Fragile Refuge – Survive inside a house that is never truly safe.

  • 🍞 Harsh Scarcity – Manage dwindling food, water, and morale.

  • 🚪 Risky Exploration – Step outside to scavenge where the undead linger.

  • 🎭 Branching Stories – Every choice reshapes your family’s fate, with multiple endings.

📢 Wishlist now and prepare to face the silence before it swallows you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 or AMD Ryzen 3 3100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 or AMD Radeon RX 480
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10600K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: 120 seconds to loot before the dead break in. A frantic escape, a car roaring into the night, and a house that becomes both prison and sanctuary. Inside, hunger, fear, and fragile hope rule. Outside, the undead wait. Survival is a story of choices.
